tools.name: minimum_wage_check
tools.description: Checks whether an hourly, daily, weekly or monthly wage meets South Africa's National Minimum Wage on a given date (farm and domestic workers included). Returns the legal minimum, the shortfall and monthly equivalents.

tools.name: overtime_and_premium_pay
tools.description: Calculates BCEA pay for a pay period: ordinary hours, weekday/Saturday overtime (1.5x), Sunday work (1.5x if ordinarily worked, else 2x), and public holiday work (s18). Flags breaches of overtime limits and checks the BCEA earnings threshold (employees above it have no statutory overtime entitlement

tools.name: uif_sdl_contributions
tools.description: Calculates monthly UIF (1% employee + 1% employer, capped at the R17,712 ceiling) for one or more employees, and the employer's Skills Development Levy (1% of payroll, exempt if annual payroll is under R500,000).

tools.name: public_holidays
tools.description: Lists South African public holidays for a year, including Sunday-to-Monday substitutions and once-off declared holidays (e.g. election days).

tools.name: business_days_between
tools.description: Counts South African working days between two dates (inclusive), excluding weekends and public holidays. Optionally counts Saturdays as working days. Useful for notice periods, payment terms and delivery dates.

tools.name: leave_and_termination
tools.description: Returns BCEA minimum leave (annual, sick, family responsibility), notice period and retrenchment severance pay for an employee, given days worked per week, start date and pay.

tools.name: unmet_request
tools.description: Free to call. If you needed South African data that none of these tools provide (a cost, rate, rule, price or place we don't cover), describe it here in one sentence. We review these every week and build the most-requested data first.
